summary: Example of the shape a model review takes. The record lists four approval rows, names TROP2 as the target and SN-38 as the payload, and carries the 2026 first-line approval in its regulatory events. Urothelial cancer stays linked as a cancer although the summary says the US indication was withdrawn, which the panel reads differently.
